about: Golden parity file for the TypeScript port of pond-v1.js (the Lotus, POND_VERSION 1). Hour index h counts from GAME_START (2026-11-10T00:00+05:30); the IST clock hour is ((h % 24) + 24) % 24. For each scenario: s = createPlant("lotus", plantH, owner); then for h = plantH .. endH - 1, s = step(s, { h, wx }, events[h] || [], SPECIES.lotus), where wx = { T, RH, P, SW, ET0, U, Ts, isDay } is index h - h0 of weather[weatherKey] (the Open-Meteo row stamped at the END of hour h; h0 = 0 unless given). Snapshots hold the state returned by step() and toVisual(state, SPECIES.lotus) whenever state.h % 6 === 0, every hour while state.h lies inside one of the scenario's hourly windows ([from, to] state hours, inclusive), plus the state at planting and after the last step. expectBloom holds expectBloom(state, SPECIES.lotus, { h: state.h, climT }) at planting and every 24 h. clock holds toVisual(state, SPECIES.lotus, t) of a few recorded states at fractional IST clock hours t (those states are inputs, stored unrounded). "Not yet" hour marks are NONE (-1e6).
rounding: Snapshot and expectBloom numbers that are not integers are stored as Math.round(x * 1000000000) / 1000000000; integers, booleans, strings and string arrays are exact. Weather, climT and constants are stored unrounded (they are inputs). A port passes when every field matches after the same rounding, allowing 1e-9 for a value that straddles a rounding boundary, and when its constants equal the constants block.
